split.rule: Assign each unique input window once, before phase filtering, curriculum sampling or augmentation; same membership in every phase and model.
split.historical_caveat: Cd200 on chr16 has already informed method development and is not a prospectively unseen biological target. New heldout scores measure sequence prediction for retrained models with fixed specification.

region_universe.not_yet_final: Existing BED peak/background selection may be target-dependent. Freeze one common accessible-region universe and add separately reported chromosome-wide eligible fixed tiling before calling performance genome-wide.

leakage_controls: No test sequence, target, or background region in any learned main, bias, differential or pretrained component.
Fit curriculum quantiles, sample balancing, normalization/calibration choices and early stopping only using training and validation as specified.
No random re-split inside any training phase and no stale caches without manifest hash validation.
Apply region caps only within training after split; preserve complete validation and test membership.
Fail benchmark on sequence/target IO errors, invalid shapes or nonfinite predictions; never score zero-filled dummy samples.
Use same masks, windows, strand convention, scaling and smoothing for all model comparisons.

target_adapter_gate.existing_modl: 4096 bp input by default, center 2048 bp supervised output; ATAC is library-normalized and conv_size=20; count target is log10(sum of that central target + 1).
target_adapter_gate.required: Choose and implement one common output interval and observed ATAC definition before retraining. Prefer common center 2048 bp if ChromBPNet's validated supported geometry permits; otherwise explicitly change and retrain MoDL count target and profile crop to a supported shared geometry. Native head outputs require verified transform into common count units.
target_adapter_gate.raw_profile_primary: Use unsmoothed insertion profiles for primary comparison when available; if retraining on bundled smoothed targets, label benchmark as normalized 20 bp-smoothed ATAC and apply identical smoothing to both models.

count_primary: Pearson correlation of log1p common observed and predicted counts
count_secondary: raw-count Poisson deviance only if true raw counts and compatible outputs are available
profile_primary: per-window Jensen-Shannon divergence of nonnegative unit-sum profiles
multinomial cross-entropy only for compatible count profiles
profile_secondary: per-window Pearson correlation at predeclared 20 bp aggregation
differential: sign concordance outside prespecified near-zero band
metrics.edge_cases: Keep genuine zero counts. Count undefined correlations and all-zero shape profiles explicitly; do not silently drop prediction zeros or nonfinite cases. Use one fixed epsilon only for numerical log/division stability, not as a biological filtering threshold.

uncertainty.sampling: Resample common genomic overlap components or larger predeclared genomic blocks within chromosome, preserving every region and all model predictions in each selected block; recompute correlations on resampled regions and report paired model differences.
uncertainty.seed_variation: Report individual training seeds and their distribution separately; block bootstrap intervals conditional on a fitted model are not training-seed uncertainty.
uncertainty.caveat: Three heldout chromosomes give limited evidence for between-chromosome variation. Report per-chromosome results and sensitivity to larger blocks; bootstrap cells/bases as independent units is invalid.

models: ChromBPNet trained on identical partitions and target intervals
ExplaiNN-inspired PWM feature baseline on matched scalar count task; label task adaptation
MoDL random trainable filters with matched capacity
MoDL fixed shuffled/negative-control motif filters with matched dimensions

interpretation.chrombpnet: Native supported DeepSHAP count and profile contributions followed by TF-MoDISco, with both heads named.
interpretation.matched_perturbation: Run identical deletion/in-silico substitution perturbations on both models and keep signed common-scale effects; raw DeepSHAP and absolute percentage deletion effects are different estimands.
interpretation.evaluation: Evaluate motif recovery on common heldout regions and robustness across training seeds; separately label the previously selected Cd200 illustrations. No objective superiority claim from three chosen loci.

generalization.required_for_broad_claim: At least one genuinely independent context or assay dataset with heldout chromosomes and target genes specified before analysis; keep donor/replicate units separate.
generalization.existing_bundle: SC1/SC1C tracks can support additional mouse contexts if independently held out, but do not alone establish human or cross-tissue transfer.
generalization.distinction: Genome-wide predictive accuracy, cross-context transfer and causal enhancer validation are separate claims. Prediction/deletion scores prioritize experiments and do not prove causation.

required_outputs: immutable source and split hashes and all component checkpoint ancestry
per-region observed/predicted profile and count outputs with region IDs, seed, context, eligibility and error flags
per-region and aggregate metric tables with bootstrap intervals and paired differences
DeepSHAP/TF-MoDISco artifacts and matched perturbation summaries
source data and a result ledger mapping every response claim to its artifact
